summary: Frontend-only verification of (a) new admin portal at /bfg-control-center-portal, (b) refactor of API base into src/lib/apiBase.js, (c) demo-trade chart crosshair follow-pointer fix, and (d) UP-button trade placement regression. All 5 requested checks PASS on the preview URL against the VPS backend api.binaryfundglobal.com. No local backend was touched.

issues: Console warning: Invalid DOM property `fetchpriority` — should be `fetchPriority`. Non-blocking but appears on every route load.

action_items: (Optional) Rename the `fetchpriority` prop to `fetchPriority` wherever it is used in JSX to silence the React dev warning.
critical_code_review_comments: apiBase.js correctly prefers REACT_APP_API_BASE over REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — verified 0 XHR calls to preview host during login + demo-trade flow.

AdminPortal error handling is robust: `errText()` unwraps FastAPI detail arrays, spinner clears in `finally`, token is only stored on success (localStorage bfg_admin_token). Handles the current 404 from the un-deployed VPS admin API gracefully.
TradeChart crosshair now uses mode:0 (Normal) with vertLine/horzLine style:0 (Solid) — matches the fix intent, confirmed visually.
Minor: React fetchpriority prop casing warning (non-blocking).
test_credentials: Trader: qa.crosshair@bfgtest.com / TestPass123! (works). Admin: none provided, VPS admin API returns 404 (expected — not yet deployed).
seed_data_creation: None. A single $1 demo trade was placed on qa.crosshair account (balance 500 -> 499).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Once the admin backend is deployed to the VPS, re-test the authenticated admin flow: stats grid, users table, search, pagination, user drawer, logout — all data-testids are already in place in /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminPortal.jsx.
